arabic: حمٓ
transliteration: Haa Meeem

translations.en.sahih: Ha, Meem.
translations.en.pickthall: Ha. Mim.
translations.en.yusufali: Ha-Mim.
translations.id.indonesian: Haa miim.

arabic: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
transliteration: Wal Kitaabil Mubeen

translations.en.sahih: By the clear Book,
translations.en.pickthall: By the Scripture that maketh plain
translations.en.yusufali: By the Book that makes things clear;-
translations.id.indonesian: Demi Kitab (Al Quran) yang menjelaskan,

arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
transliteration: Innaaa anzalnaahu fee lailatim mubaarakah; innaa kunnaa munzireen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning -
translations.en.yusufali: We sent it down during a Blessed Night: for We (ever) wish to warn (against Evil).
translations.id.indonesian: sesungguhnya Kami menurunkannya pada suatu malam yang diberkahi dan sesungguhnya Kami-lah yang memberi peringatan.

arabic: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
transliteration: Feehaa yufraqu kullu amrin hakeem

translations.en.sahih: On that night is made distinct every precise matter -
translations.en.pickthall: Whereon every wise command is made clear
translations.en.yusufali: In the (Night) is made distinct every affair of wisdom,
translations.id.indonesian: Pada malam itu dijelaskan segala urusan yang penuh hikmah,

arabic: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
transliteration: Amram min 'indinaaa; innaa kunnaa mursileen

translations.en.sahih: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
translations.en.pickthall: As a command from Our presence - Lo! We are ever sending -
translations.en.yusufali: By command, from Our Presence. For We (ever) send (revelations),
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) urusan yang besar dari sisi Kami. Sesungguhnya Kami adalah Yang mengutus rasul-rasul,

arabic: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Rahmatam mir rabbik; innahoo Huwas Samee'ul 'Aleem

translations.en.sahih: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
translations.en.pickthall: A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower,
translations.en.yusufali: As Mercy from thy Lord: for He hears and knows (all things);
translations.id.indonesian: sebagai rahmat dari Tuhanmu. Sesungguhnya Dialah Yang Maha Mendengar lagi Maha Mengetahui,

arabic: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
transliteration: Rabbis samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa; in kuntum mooqineen

translations.en.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.
translations.en.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure.
translations.en.yusufali: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all between them, if ye (but) have an assured faith.
translations.id.indonesian: Tuhan Yang memelihara langit dan bumi dan apa yang ada di antara keduanya, jika kamu adalah orang yang meyakini.

arabic: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
transliteration: Laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa yuhyee wa yumeetu Rabbukum wa Rabbu aabaaa'ikumul awwaleen

translations.en.sahih: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
translations.en.pickthall: There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers.
translations.en.yusufali: There is no god but He: It is He Who gives life and gives death,- The Lord and Cherisher to you and your earliest ancestors.
translations.id.indonesian: Tidak ada Tuhan (yang berhak disembah) melainkan Dia, Yang menghidupkan dan Yang mematikan (Dialah) Tuhanmu dan Tuhan bapak-bapakmu yang terdahulu.

arabic: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
transliteration: Bal hum fee shakkiny yal'aboon

translations.en.sahih: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but they play in doubt.
translations.en.yusufali: Yet they play about in doubt.
translations.id.indonesian: Tetapi mereka bermain-main dalam keragu-raguan.

arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
transliteration: Fartaqib Yawma taatis samaaa'u bidukhaanim mubeen

translations.en.sahih: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke.
translations.en.pickthall: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke
translations.en.yusufali: Then watch thou for the Day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke (or mist) plainly visible,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka tunggulah hari ketika langit membawa kabut yang nyata,

arabic: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
transliteration: Yaghshan naasa haazaa 'azaabun aleem

translations.en.sahih: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.
translations.en.pickthall: That will envelop the people. This will be a painful torment.
translations.en.yusufali: Enveloping the people: this will be a Penalty Grievous.
translations.id.indonesian: yang meliputi manusia. Inilah azab yang pedih.

arabic: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
transliteration: Rabbanak shif 'annal 'azaaba innaa mu'minoon

translations.en.sahih: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."
translations.en.pickthall: (Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment. Lo! we are believers.
translations.en.yusufali: (They will say:) "Our Lord! remove the Penalty from us, for we do really believe!"
translations.id.indonesian: (Mereka berdoa): "Ya Tuhan kami, lenyapkanlah dari kami azab itu. Sesungguhnya kami akan beriman".

arabic: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
transliteration: Annaa lahumuz zikraa wa qad jaaa'ahum Rasoolum mubeen

translations.en.sahih: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.
translations.en.pickthall: How can there be remembrance for them, when a messenger making plain (the Truth) had already come unto them,
translations.en.yusufali: How shall the message be (effectual) for them, seeing that an Messenger explaining things clearly has (already) come to them,-
translations.id.indonesian: Bagaimanakah mereka dapat menerima peringatan, padahal telah datang kepada mereka seorang rasul yang memberi penjelasan,

arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
transliteration: Summaa tawallaw 'anhu wa qaaloo mu'allamum majnoon

translations.en.sahih: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."
translations.en.pickthall: And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman?
translations.en.yusufali: Yet they turn away from him and say: "Tutored (by others), a man possessed!"
translations.id.indonesian: kemudian mereka berpaling daripadanya dan berkata: "Dia adalah seorang yang menerima ajaran (dari orang lain) lagi pula seorang yang gila".

arabic: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
transliteration: Innaa kaashiful 'azaabi qaleelaa; innakum 'aaa'indoon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We withdraw the torment a little. Lo! ye return (to disbelief).
translations.en.yusufali: We shall indeed remove the Penalty for a while, (but) truly ye will revert (to your ways).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya (kalau) Kami akan melenyapkan siksaan itu agak sedikit sesungguhnya kamu akan kembali (ingkar).

arabic: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
transliteration: Yawma nabtishul batsha tal kubraa innaa muntaqimoon

translations.en.sahih: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.
translations.en.pickthall: On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish.
translations.en.yusufali: One day We shall seize you with a mighty onslaught: We will indeed (then) exact Retribution!
translations.id.indonesian: (Ingatlah) hari (ketika) Kami menghantam mereka dengan hantaman yang keras. Sesungguhnya Kami adalah Pemberi balasan.

arabic: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
transliteration: Wa laqad fatannaa qablahum qawma Fir'awna wa jaaa'ahum Rasoolun kareem

translations.en.sahih: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger,
translations.en.pickthall: And verily We tried before them Pharaoh's folk, when there came unto them a noble messenger,
translations.en.yusufali: We did, before them, try the people of Pharaoh: there came to them a messenger most honourable,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya sebelum mereka telah Kami uji kaum Fir'aun dan telah datang kepada mereka seorang rasul yang mulia,

arabic: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
transliteration: An addooo ilaiya 'ibaadal laahi innee lakum Rasoolun ameen

translations.en.sahih: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"
translations.en.pickthall: Saying: Give up to me the slaves of Allah. Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you.
translations.en.yusufali: Saying: "Restore to me the Servants of Allah: I am to you an messenger worthy of all trust;
translations.id.indonesian: (dengan berkata): "Serahkanlah kepadaku hamba-hamba Allah (Bani Israil yang kamu perbudak). Sesungguhnya aku adalah utusan (Allah) yang dipercaya kepadamu,

arabic: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
transliteration: Wa al laa ta'loo 'alal laahi innee aateekum bisultaanim mubeen

translations.en.sahih: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority.
translations.en.pickthall: And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant.
translations.en.yusufali: "And be not arrogant as against Allah: for I come to you with authority manifest.
translations.id.indonesian: dan janganlah kamu menyombongkan diri terhadap Allah. Sesungguhnya aku datang kepadamu dengan membawa bukti yang nyata.

arabic: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
transliteration: Wa innee 'uztu bi Rabbee wa rabbikum an tarjumoon

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death.
translations.en.yusufali: "For me, I have sought safety with my Lord and your Lord, against your injuring me.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya aku berlindung kepada Tuhanku dan Tuhanmu, dari keinginanmu merajamku,

arabic: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
transliteration: Wa il lam tu'minoo lee fa'taziloon

translations.en.sahih: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."
translations.en.pickthall: And if ye put no faith in me, then let me go.
translations.en.yusufali: "If ye believe me not, at least keep yourselves away from me."
translations.id.indonesian: dan jika kamu tidak beriman kepadaku maka biarkanlah aku (memimpin Bani Israil)".

arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
transliteration: Fada'aa rabbahooo anna haaa'ulaaa'i qawmum mujrimoon

translations.en.sahih: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.
translations.en.pickthall: And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk.
translations.en.yusufali: (But they were aggressive:) then he cried to his Lord: "These are indeed a people given to sin."
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian Musa berdoa kepada Tuhannya: "Sesungguhnya mereka ini adalah kaum yang berdosa (segerakanlah azab kepada mereka)".

arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
transliteration: Fa asri bi'ibaadee lailan innakum muttaba'oon

translations.en.sahih: [Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.
translations.en.pickthall: Then (his Lord commanded): Take away My slaves by night. Lo! ye will be followed,
translations.en.yusufali: (The reply came:) "March forth with My Servants by night: for ye are sure to be pursued.
translations.id.indonesian: (Allah berfirman): "Maka berjalanlah kamu dengan membawa hamba-hamba-Ku pada malam hari, sesungguhnya kamu akan dikejar,

arabic: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
transliteration: Watrukil bahra rahwan innahum jundum mughraqoon

translations.en.sahih: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
translations.en.pickthall: And leave the sea behind at rest, for lo! they are a drowned host.
translations.en.yusufali: "And leave the sea as a furrow (divided): for they are a host (destined) to be drowned."
translations.id.indonesian: dan biarkanlah laut itu tetap terbelah. Sesungguhnya mereka adalah tentara yang akan ditenggelamkan".

arabic: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
transliteration: Kam tarakoo min jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

translations.en.sahih: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
translations.en.pickthall: How many were the gardens and the watersprings that they left behind,
translations.en.yusufali: How many were the gardens and springs they left behind,
translations.id.indonesian: Alangkah banyaknya taman dan mata air yang mereka tinggalkan,

arabic: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
transliteration: Wa zuroo'inw wa maqaa min kareem

translations.en.sahih: And crops and noble sites
translations.en.pickthall: And the cornlands and the goodly sites
translations.en.yusufali: And corn-fields and noble buildings,
translations.id.indonesian: dan kebun-kebun serta tempat-tempat yang indah-indah,

arabic: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ
transliteration: Wa na'matin kaanoo feehaa faakiheen

translations.en.sahih: And comfort wherein they were amused.
translations.en.pickthall: And pleasant things wherein they took delight!
translations.en.yusufali: And wealth (and conveniences of life), wherein they had taken such delight!
translations.id.indonesian: dan kesenangan-kesenangan yang mereka menikmatinya,

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
transliteration: Kazaalika wa awrasnaahaa qawman aakhareen

translations.en.sahih: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.
translations.en.pickthall: Even so (it was), and We made it an inheritance for other folk;
translations.en.yusufali: Thus (was their end)! And We made other people inherit (those things)!
translations.id.indonesian: demikianlah. Dan Kami wariskan semua itu kepada kaum yang lain.

arabic: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
transliteration: Famaa bakat 'alaihimus samaaa'u wal ardu wa maa kaanoo munzareen

translations.en.sahih: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
translations.en.pickthall: And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
translations.en.yusufali: And neither heaven nor earth shed a tear over them: nor were they given a respite (again).
translations.id.indonesian: Maka langit dan bumi tidak menangisi mereka dan merekapun tidak diberi tangguh.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
transliteration: Wa laqad najjainaa Baneee Israaa'eela minal'azaabil muheen

translations.en.sahih: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -
translations.en.pickthall: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom;
translations.en.yusufali: We did deliver aforetime the Children of Israel from humiliating Punishment,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami selamatkan Bani Israil dari siksa yang menghinakan,

arabic: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
transliteration: Min Fir'awn; innahoo kaana 'aaliyam minal musrifeen

translations.en.sahih: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.
translations.en.pickthall: (We delivered them) from Pharaoh. Lo! he was a tyrant of the wanton ones.
translations.en.yusufali: Inflicted by Pharaoh, for he was arrogant (even) among inordinate transgressors.
translations.id.indonesian: dari (azab) Fir'aun. Sesungguhnya dia adalah orang yang sombong, salah seorang dari orang-orang yang melampaui batas.

arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
transliteration: Wa laqadikh tarnaahum 'alaa 'ilmin 'alal 'aalameen

translations.en.sahih: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.
translations.en.pickthall: And We chose them, purposely, above (all) creatures.
translations.en.yusufali: And We chose them aforetime above the nations, knowingly,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami pilih mereka dengan pengetahuan (Kami) atas bangsa-bangsa.

arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
transliteration: Wa aatainaahum minal aayaati maa feehi balaaa'um mubeen

translations.en.sahih: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.
translations.en.pickthall: And We gave them portents wherein was a clear trial.
translations.en.yusufali: And granted them Signs in which there was a manifest trial
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami telah memberikan kepada mereka di antara tanda-tanda kekuasaan (Kami) sesuatu yang di dalamnya terdapat nikmat yang nyata.

arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
transliteration: Inna haaa'ulaaa'i la yaqooloon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! these, forsooth, are saying:
translations.en.yusufali: As to these (Quraish), they say forsooth:
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya mereka (kaum musyrik) itu benar-benar berkata,

arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
transliteration: In hiya illaa mawtatunal oolaa wa maa nahnu bimun shareen

translations.en.sahih: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
translations.en.pickthall: There is naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again.
translations.en.yusufali: "There is nothing beyond our first death, and we shall not be raised again.
translations.id.indonesian: "tidak ada kematian selain kematian di dunia ini. Dan kami sekali-kali tidak akan dibangkitkan,

arabic: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
transliteration: Faatoo bi aabaaa'inaaa inkuntum saadiqeen

translations.en.sahih: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
translations.en.pickthall: Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth!
translations.en.yusufali: "Then bring (back) our forefathers, if what ye say is true!"
translations.id.indonesian: maka datangkanlah (kembali) bapak-bapak kami jika kamu memang orang-orang yang benar".

arabic: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
transliteration: Ahum khayrun am qawmu Tubba'inw wallazeena min qablihim; ahlaknaahum innahum kaanoo mujrimeen

translations.en.sahih: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.
translations.en.pickthall: Are they better, or the folk of Tubb'a and those before them? We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty.
translations.en.yusufali: What! Are they better than the people of Tubba and those who were before them? We destroyed them because they were guilty of sin.
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah mereka (kaum musyrikin) yang lebih baik ataukah kaum Tubba' dan orang-orang yang sebelum mereka. Kami telah membinasakan mereka karena sesungguhnya mereka adalah orang-orang yang berdosa.

arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
transliteration: Wa maa khalaqnas samaawaati wal arda wa maa baina humaa laa'ibeen

translations.en.sahih: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
translations.en.pickthall: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play.
translations.en.yusufali: We created not the heavens, the earth, and all between them, merely in (idle) sport:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami tidak menciptakan langit dan bumi dan apa yang ada antara keduanya dengan bermain-main.

arabic: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Maa khalaqnaahumaaa illaa bilhaqqi wa laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon

translations.en.sahih: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.
translations.en.pickthall: We created them not save with truth; but most of them know not.
translations.en.yusufali: We created them not except for just ends: but most of them do not understand.
translations.id.indonesian: Kami tidak menciptakan keduanya melainkan dengan haq, tetapi kebanyakan mereka tidak mengetahui.

arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
transliteration: Inna yawmal fasli meeqaatuhum ajma'een

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -
translations.en.pickthall: Assuredly the Day of Decision is the term for all of them,
translations.en.yusufali: Verily the Day of sorting out is the time appointed for all of them,-
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya hari keputusan (hari kiamat) itu adalah waktu yang dijanjikan bagi mereka semuanya,

arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
transliteration: Yawma laa yughnee mawlan 'am mawlan shai'anw wa laa hum yunsaroon

translations.en.sahih: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
translations.en.pickthall: A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped,
translations.en.yusufali: The Day when no protector can avail his client in aught, and no help can they receive,
translations.id.indonesian: yaitu hari yang seorang karib tidak dapat memberi manfaat kepada karibnya sedikitpun, dan mereka tidak akan mendapat pertolongan,

arabic: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Illaa mar rahimal laah' innahoo huwal 'azeezur raheem

translations.en.sahih: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
translations.en.pickthall: Save him on whom Allah hath mercy. Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
translations.en.yusufali: Except such as receive Allah's Mercy: for He is Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali orang yang diberi rahmat oleh Allah. Sesungguhnya Dialah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Penyayang.

arabic: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
transliteration: Inna shajarataz zaqqoom

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the tree of zaqqum
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! the tree of Zaqqum,
translations.en.yusufali: Verily the tree of Zaqqum
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya pohon zaqqum itu,

arabic: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
transliteration: Ta'aamul aseem

translations.en.sahih: Is food for the sinful.
translations.en.pickthall: The food of the sinner!
translations.en.yusufali: Will be the food of the Sinful,-
translations.id.indonesian: makanan orang yang banyak berdosa.

arabic: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
transliteration: Kalmuhli yaghlee filbutoon

translations.en.sahih: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
translations.en.pickthall: Like molten brass, it seetheth in their bellies
translations.en.yusufali: Like molten brass; it will boil in their insides.
translations.id.indonesian: (Ia) sebagai kotoran minyak yang mendidih di dalam perut,

arabic: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
transliteration: Kaghalyil hameem

translations.en.sahih: Like the boiling of scalding water.
translations.en.pickthall: As the seething of boiling water.
translations.en.yusufali: Like the boiling of scalding water.
translations.id.indonesian: seperti mendidihnya air yang amat panas.

arabic: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
transliteration: Khuzoohu fa'tiloohu ilaa sawaaa'il Jaheem

translations.en.sahih: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,
translations.en.pickthall: (And it will be said): Take him and drag him to the midst of hell,
translations.en.yusufali: (A voice will cry: "Seize ye him and drag him into the midst of the Blazing Fire!
translations.id.indonesian: Peganglah dia kemudian seretlah dia ke tengah-tengah neraka.

arabic: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
transliteration: Summa subboo fawqa raasihee min 'azaabil hameem

translations.en.sahih: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."
translations.en.pickthall: Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water.
translations.en.yusufali: "Then pour over his head the Penalty of Boiling Water,
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian tuangkanlah di atas kepalanya siksaan (dari) air yang amat panas.

arabic: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
transliteration: Zuq innaka antal 'azeezul kareem

translations.en.sahih: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!
translations.en.pickthall: (Saying): Taste! Lo! thou wast forsooth the mighty, the noble!
translations.en.yusufali: "Taste thou (this)! Truly wast thou mighty, full of honour!
translations.id.indonesian: Rasakanlah, sesungguhnya kamu orang yang perkasa lagi mulia.

arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
transliteration: Inna haazaa maa kuntum bihee tamtaroon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! this is that whereof ye used to doubt.
translations.en.yusufali: "Truly this is what ye used to doubt!"
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya ini adalah azab yang dahulu selalu kamu meragu-ragukannya.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
transliteration: Innal muttaqeena fee maqaamin ameen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place;
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! those who kept their duty will be in a place secured.
translations.en.yusufali: As to the Righteous (they will be) in a position of Security,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang bertakwa berada dalam tempat yang aman,

arabic: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
transliteration: Fee jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

translations.en.sahih: Within gardens and springs,
translations.en.pickthall: Amid gardens and watersprings,
translations.en.yusufali: Among Gardens and Springs;
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) di dalam taman-taman dan mata-air-mata-air;

arabic: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
transliteration: Yalbasoona min sundusinw wa istbraqim mutaqaabileen

translations.en.sahih: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.
translations.en.pickthall: Attired in silk and silk embroidery, facing one another.
translations.en.yusufali: Dressed in fine silk and in rich brocade, they will face each other;
translations.id.indonesian: mereka memakai sutera yang halus dan sutera yang tebal, (duduk) berhadap-hadapan,

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
transliteration: Kazaalika wa zawwajnaahum bihoorin 'een

translations.en.sahih: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
translations.en.pickthall: Even so (it will be). And We shall wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.
translations.en.yusufali: So; and We shall join them to fair women with beautiful, big, and lustrous eyes.
translations.id.indonesian: demikianlah. Dan Kami berikan kepada mereka bidadari.

arabic: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
transliteration: Yad'oona feehaa bikulli faakihatin aamineen

translations.en.sahih: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.
translations.en.pickthall: They call therein for every fruit in safety.
translations.en.yusufali: There can they call for every kind of fruit in peace and security;
translations.id.indonesian: Di dalamnya mereka meminta segala macam buah-buahan dengan aman (dari segala kekhawatiran),

arabic: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
transliteration: Laa yazooqoona feehal mawtaa illal mawtatal oolaa wa qaqaahum 'azaabal jaheem

translations.en.sahih: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
translations.en.pickthall: They taste not death therein, save the first death. And He hath saved them from the doom of hell,
translations.en.yusufali: Nor will they there taste Death, except the first death; and He will preserve them from the Penalty of the Blazing Fire,-
translations.id.indonesian: mereka tidak akan merasakan mati di dalamnya kecuali mati di dunia. Dan Allah memelihara mereka dari azab neraka,

arabic: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
transliteration: Fadlam mir rabbik; zaalika huwal fawzul 'azeem

translations.en.sahih: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.
translations.en.pickthall: A bounty from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph.
translations.en.yusufali: As a Bounty from thy Lord! that will be the supreme achievement!
translations.id.indonesian: sebagai karunia dari Tuhanmu. Yang demikian itu adalah keberuntungan yang besar.

arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
transliteration: Fa innamaa yassarnaahu bilisaanika la'allahum yatazakkaroon

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded.
translations.en.pickthall: And We have made (this Scripture) easy in thy language only that they may heed.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily, We have made this (Qur'an) easy, in thy tongue, in order that they may give heed.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami mudahkan Al Quran itu dengan bahasamu supaya mereka mendapat pelajaran.

arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
transliteration: Fartaqib innahum murta qiboon

translations.en.sahih: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
translations.en.pickthall: Wait then (O Muhammad). Lo! they (too) are waiting.
translations.en.yusufali: So wait thou and watch; for they (too) are waiting.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka tunggulah; sesungguhnya mereka itu menunggu (pula).
